first_scan_gate_enabled.description: v3.2.0 growth program flip 2026-07-10 — v3.2.0+ only: older builds contain the pre-fix scan

d1_overnight_drain_enabled.description: v3.1.11 W1: D1OvernightDrainWorker 20h push. TRUE for 50% via Firebase installation-id bucketing.

widget_pin_prompt_enabled.description: ON 2026-08-28 (was OFF since 2026-07-10). 5/116 installs pinned the widget; 81 saw the preview (6% conv). One-time prompt after a good scan. See project_devicegpt_behavior_baseline memory.

enable_leaderboard.description: Owner override 2026-07-10: leaderboard is a core surface. Reverted my unilateral disable.

tab_order.description: Health first 2026-09-08 (owner call). New users landed on Leaderboard: ad on top, top-3 blurred, no rank card. Score card + insight + Timeline live on Health, unseen by new users. Leaderboard KEPT at pos 2.

show_app_open_ads.description: OFF for builds < 3.1.17: those requested 18,124 app-open ads and showed 59 (0.38%) - wasted spend + AdMob invalid-traffic risk. 3.1.17+ fixed the pipeline (headless requests removed, ad auto-shows on arrival), so ads are ON there.

paywall_delay_enabled.description: ON 2026-08-28, commit 51495f0. Gates cold-open paywall on session>=3 + 1 scan. Was FALSE: paywall showed session 1, 717 shows/418 sessions, 0 purchases/28d, 73% uninstall, D1 8.6%.

paywall_reason_routing_enabled.description: ON 2026-08-28 w/ paywall_delay_enabled. REQUIRED: onDismissReason() only writes cooldown state when true. no_response+sheet_dismissed=78% of dismissals now route to COOLDOWN_7D instead of LOG_ONLY.

app_open_ad_min_session.description: 10 (was 3, 2026-10-07 owner-approved churn stop-gap: sessions 1-9 have no app-open ad). Bundled default is 1L (NO gate) despite app_open_manager.kt:288 claiming 3. See docs/CHURN-DIAGNOSIS-2026-10-07.md.

ads_grace_sessions.description: 10 (was 2; 2026-10-07 owner-approved churn stop-gap: no interstitials in sessions 1-10). Honoured by BOTH showAdBeforeAction and showAdIfAvailable (3632d72, in vc50). See debugger docs/CHURN-DIAGNOSIS-2026-10-07.md.

show_leaderboard_interstitial_ads.description: OFF 2026-09-08. Interstitial fired on the landing tab. Ads are the only repeated 1-star complaint - 2 of 4 negatives, two languages, five months apart.

review_delay_first_launch_ms.description: 24h, was 15000. Review sheet landed 15s into session 1 (MIN_APP_OPENS=1 = no gate). review_requested reached 73-130% of installs on an app with 148% uninstall. Proper gate is a code fix.

enable_review_first_strategy.description: 2026-10-08: off. The paywall opened right after the in-app review flow (even when Play showed no dialog) - 'rate us' then 'pay us'.
